name: signature-replay-vault
inspiration: SWC-121 missing protection against signature replay

known_bugs.description: The signed digest covers only recipient and amount, with no nonce, deadline or record of spent authorizations, so a single signature can be submitted repeatedly until the vault is empty.

The constructor does not reject a zero signer, and ecrecover returns address(0) for a malformed signature. A vault deployed with signer == address(0) therefore accepts any garbage signature and releases funds to an attacker-chosen recipient. Deployment-contingent.

Payout uses to.transfer(amount), whose fixed 2300 gas stipend cannot cover a contract recipient with non-trivial receive logic. A validly authorized contract recipient can never be paid and its funds are stranded, since release is the only withdrawal path.
